fields.description: Passwordless first-factor login with a passkey (and the login page UI)
fields.label: Login with Passkey

fields.description: Use a passkey as the second factor after password login; requires Two Factor Authentication to be enabled in System Settings
fields.label: Passkey as Second Factor

fields.description: Allow a mid-flow fallback to the configured OTP method when the passkey second factor fails
fields.label: Allow OTP Fallback for Passkey Second Factor

fields.description: Changing the RP ID invalidates every existing passkey. This cannot be undone. Blank resolves to the exact host of the site's configured host_name when a login mode is enabled.
fields.label: Passkey RP ID

fields.description: Additional allowed origins, one per line (explicit ports allowed). Each must be HTTPS and within the RP ID's scope.
fields.label: Passkey Origins
Resolved Configuration
fields.options: The resolved RP ID and origins are validated when a login mode is enabled.

fields.description: Native app origins that may assert the site's passkeys, one per line. A native Android app presents android:apk-key-hash:<hash>, where <hash> is the unpadded base64url SHA-256 of its signing certificate; use Google's Play app-signing certificate (Play Console → App integrity → App signing), NOT the upload key. iOS needs no entry here; configure its https://<RP ID> value under Passkey Origins. Serve the association files (assetlinks.json / apple-app-site-association) so a native app can share these passkeys; see docs/mobile-apps.md.
fields.label: Trusted App Origins

fields.description: Android application id for the served /.well-known/assetlinks.json, e.g. com.example.app. Leave blank to omit assetlinks.json.
fields.label: Android Package Name

fields.description: SHA-256 signing-certificate fingerprint(s) for assetlinks.json, one per line (hex; colons optional). Use Google's Play app-signing certificate (Play Console → App integrity → App signing); include the upload key too during rollout. Required together with the package name to serve assetlinks.json.
fields.label: Android Signing Certificate SHA-256 Fingerprints

fields.description: Apple Team ID (App ID Prefix) for the served /.well-known/apple-app-site-association, e.g. ABCDE12345.
fields.label: iOS Team ID

fields.description: iOS bundle identifier for apple-app-site-association, e.g. com.example.app. Team ID and Bundle ID are both required to serve the file.
fields.label: iOS Bundle ID

fields.description: Reject logins on a signature-counter regression instead of logging and flagging the credential
fields.label: Hard-fail on Sign Count Regression

fields.description: Seconds a fresh login or re-authentication satisfies the sudo gate for passkey management
fields.label: Re-authentication Window (Seconds)

fields.description: Let accounts without a usable password (social login only) enroll their first passkey shortly after an interactive login
fields.label: Allow First Enrollment on Weak Login

fields.description: The adoption ladder rung. Off: no prompt. Nudge: cadence-capped, dismissible enrollment prompt. Enforce: in-scope users must register a passkey to keep using the app (recovery stays available). Enforce After Date: behaves as Nudge until the date, then Enforce. Enforce is a post-login interstitial: the session already exists before it runs, so it raises friction toward enrollment but is not a server-side authentication block.
fields.label: Enrollment Policy
fields.options:
Off
Nudge
Enforce
Enforce After Date

fields.description: Enforcement begins on this date (evaluated against the server clock on every request). Before it, the policy behaves as Nudge; a past date behaves as immediate Enforce.
fields.label: Enforce After

fields.description: How many times the dismissible enrollment nudge may appear before it stops. Governs the Nudge cadence only, so it is hidden under Off (no prompt) and Enforce (the enforcement interstitial owns the surface); under 'Enforce After Date' it still applies during the pre-date Nudge phase.
fields.label: Maximum Nudge Prompts

fields.description: Minimum days between nudge prompts. Governs the Nudge cadence only, so it is hidden under Off and Enforce; under 'Enforce After Date' it still applies during the pre-date Nudge phase.
fields.label: Nudge Cooldown (Days)

fields.description: Silently upgrade password users to a passkey where the browser supports conditional create
fields.label: Conditional Create

fields.description: Whether enforcement applies to everyone or only to users holding one of the selected roles.
fields.label: Enforcement Scope

fields.description: A user is in scope for enforcement if they hold any of these roles.
fields.label: Enforce for Roles

fields.description: Users holding any of these roles are always exempt (break-glass). System Manager is seeded here by default so an administrator can never lock themselves out.
fields.label: Exempt Roles

fields.description: How many more sign-ins an in-scope user may defer the enrollment prompt before it becomes blocking. Covers brand-new users' first session; 0 blocks immediately.
fields.label: Grace Logins

fields.description: What to do when a device genuinely cannot create a passkey (no platform authenticator and no cross-device option). Degrade to Nudge never locks the device out; Block + Notify Admin keeps prompting and records a risk event instead.
fields.label: Incapable Device Policy
fields.options:
Degrade to Nudge
Block + Notify Admin

fields.description: On a device with no platform authenticator, offer enrollment via a phone / QR code (cross-device) so capable-via-phone users are not dead-ended.
fields.label: Allow Hybrid (Phone / QR) Enrollment

fields.description: Email the user when a passkey is added, removed, disabled or flagged. This is the compensating control for registration hijack — leave it on outside mail-less development sites.
fields.label: Notify on Passkey Changes

fields.description: Email the user when a passkey holder signs in with a weaker method
fields.label: Notify on Password Fallback

fields.description: Record a risk event when a user who has a passkey signs in with their password instead (Activity Log telemetry; off by default)
fields.label: Notify on Password Login by Passkey Holder
